newsitem.title: USA: IPO SPOTLIGHT - "Odd Jobs" Mazel debut looks solid.
newsitem.headline: IPO SPOTLIGHT - "Odd Jobs" Mazel debut looks solid.

text.p: Mazel Stores Inc's planned initial public offering could spark some serious investor interest despite a somewhat soft IPO market.
The Solon, Ohio company runs a closeout buying business from wholesalers and distributes and sells through its "Odd-Job trading" line of 19 deep-discount stores in the New York metropolitan area.
Vincent Slavin, who tracks IPOs for Cantor Fitzgerald, said he expected the stock to open up possibly between $0.50 and $1.00 from its IPO price in aftermarket trading.
